content:
There are a lot of ways to connect with the creative community this month at the Bay City Arts Center. Whether you’re interested in theater, music, painting, or gathering with others in a meaningful creative community, there’s something for you at the arts center this month.

October Artists of the Month
Gallery Reception: Friday, October 2, 5–7 p.m.
BCAC’s October exhibitions will usher you into the darker half of the year with the Macabre Humanist works of Cathy Gordon, ceramic carved pumpkins by Stacy Mason, and concrete skulls by Ryan Scott in the downstairs gallery. Justin Howard in the upstairs gallery will take you on a journey of child-like adventure along the Oregon Coast. Meet the artists and join in the creative community at the Friday gallery opening.

Pass the Treasures Market
Saturday, October 3rd | 9am – 4 pm
Come find your next treasure at our multi-vendor indoor/outdoor sale. Whether you’re looking for artwork, sound equipment, antiques, art supplies, or curiosities, there may be something here for you.

Open Auditions for “The Guy Who Didn’t Like Musicals”
Saturday October 10th and Sunday October 11th | 12pm – 4pm
This meta-comedy about a man who enters a world where everyone bursts into song is perfect for actors, singers, and anyone brave enough to tackle the unexpected! Come any time during open auditions with a short comedic monologue and 16 bars of a song. Rehearsals will be Saturdays and Sundays 6-9pm starting November 1st with a dress rehearsal December 17th. Performances will be December 18th, 19th, and 20th at BCAC.
Open to adults 18+.

Oil Painting with Erica Robin
Open Studio Monday Nights 5pm-8pm
Bring your friends and join oil painting artist Erica Robin on Monday nights throughout October for a free opportunity to work on your own project with the support of an expert. Painting supplies are available for purchase, or you can bring your own.
October 24th | 10 a.m.– 12:30 p.m.
Create a Halloween-themed piece and learn the basics of oil painting in a welcoming, hands-on workshop with Erica Robin.
$75 per person / $65 BCAC members
For registration and more information, visit the Bay City Arts Center, 5580 B Street in Bay City, or find BCAC online at baycityartscenter.com.

The Glensiders – An Evening of Celtic Folk Music
Saturday, October 24th | 6 p.m.
Join us for a fun evening of sea shanties, storytelling, and sing-alongs celebrating the culture and music of the Gaelic nations. Admission: $15 for adults; Free for kids
Food donations are also welcome in lieu of admission. Non-perishable donations will be distributed to local families.

Looking forward to November? Save these dates:
November 4th, 10am – 2pm – Native American Marketplace
November 4th, 1-3pm- Lifeways of Tillamook People Storytelling Event
